name: ARCH Medical Solutions - Seabrook
old_description: ARCH Medical Solutions is your trusted resource for additive manufacturing, precision machining, validated processes, and related supply chain integration. At high-tech facilities across the country, we bring deep experience to the development of orthopedic, spine, and dental implants and instruments, navigated and robotic-assisted surgical devices, and precision components for surgical robotic systems, biomedical machines, and life sciences equipment.
about:
ARCH Medical Solutions operates a facility in Seabrook, New Hampshire, as part of a national network of high-tech sites serving the medical device sector. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in public materials.

The Seabrook location contributes to a scalable manufacturing footprint that spans multiple facilities nationwide. Core processes include powder-bed fusion additive manufacturing — with over a decade of experience — precision CNC machining, medical grinding for surgical cutting instruments, and a suite of finishing services such as ultrasonic cleaning, bead blasting, and laser marking. The company also provides assembly, subassembly, inspection, kitting, packaging, and just-in-time shipping as part of its supply chain integration offering.

ARCH Medical Solutions serves medical OEMs developing orthopedic, spine, and dental implants and instruments, as well as navigated and robotic-assisted surgical devices. Its customer base includes makers of precision components for surgical robotic systems, biomedical machines, and life sciences equipment.

The company positions itself as a single-source partner for validated processes and supply chain integration, emphasizing a collaborative engineering approach and a proven transition process for outsourced manufacturing. Its stated mission centers on improving patient outcomes through precision manufacturing.
